description_en: Generates a template for a resource scenario
kebab_example: aliyun ros generate-template-by-scratch --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --template-scratch-id ts-aa9c62feab844a6b0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GenerateTemplateByScratch

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the resource scenario.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/131035.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
资源场景所属的地域ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/131035.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource scenario.

For more information about how to query the IDs of resource scenarios, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/363050.html
parameters.help_zh:
资源场景ID。

关于如何获取资源场景ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/363050.html
parameters.name: template_scratch_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the new node
parameters.name: provision_region_id

parameters.help_en: The type of the template that Resource Orchestration Service (ROS) generates. ROS can generate templates of the ROS and Terraform types. Default value: ROS
parameters.help_zh: 生成模板类型，支持生成ROS和Terraform类型的模板，默认为ROS
parameters.name: template_type

ResourcesToImport.description_en:
The resources that you want to import into a stack in the resource management scenario.

This parameter is returned only for a resource management scenario
ResourcesToImport.description_zh:
资源纳管类型的资源场景中，待导入资源栈的资源。

仅资源纳管类型的资源场景支持返回该参数

LogicalResourceId.description_en: The logical ID of the resource

ResourceIdentifier.description_en:
The key-value mapping between strings. The value is a JSON string that identifies the resource that you want to import into a stack.
A key is an identifier for a resource, and a value is an assignment of data to the key. For example, VpcId is a key that indicates the ID of a virtual private cloud (VPC), and `vpc-bp1m6fww66xbntjyc****"` is a value that is assigned to VpcId
ResourceIdentifier.description_zh:
字符串到字符串的键值映射。取值是JSON格式的字符串，用来标识要导入的资源。  
键是资源的标识符属性（例如：ALIYUN::ECS::VPC资源的VpcId），值是属性的取值（例如：`vpc-bp1m6fww66xbntjyc****"`）

TemplateBody.description_en: The template content of the resource scenario
TemplateBody.description_zh: 资源场景中生成的模板内容
